data.title: Stacks Successfully Activates PoX-5, Laying the Foundation for Bitcoin Staking
data.description: New York, New York, July 30th, 2026, ChainwireStacks today activated the PoX-5 hardfork at Bitcoin block 960,230, successfully establishing the protocol foundation for Bitcoin Staking. The network upgrade completed without interruption, with core contributors verifying the activation following post…
